title: Loading resources from PCK is 5-10x slower in Android export
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1-stable
4.3-stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - macOS Sonoma (14.5.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Pro 560X OpenGL Engine - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8850H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

I'm trying to use PCK in Android export to protect my content. However, loading resources from PCK is much slower than loading from assets dir. In my MRP, it appears 5x slower. In my working project, it feels like near 10x slower. My test device is LG G7.

Here is the test output of my MRP. I also tried it in editor. In editor, PCK resource loading even outperforms loading from dir. And I tried to set script export option to binary tokens, which showed little effect. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3bf8edae-885d-499f-9526-45d69d920fe7)

I tried to use Android Studio to profile it. But I'm new to Android development and can not figure out. I only saw a lot of FileAccessAndroid::seek calls in GL thread.

### Steps to reproduce

MRP exports 500 scripts and 500 scenes to assets dir and pck respectively. Export an apk and run it on Android device. It will show the loading times. 

In the main scene, there is an embeded script running the test.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[slowpck.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19933398/slowpck.zip)
